description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and data structures related to streaming and grain counters in a distributed Orleans-based system.

classes.name: StreamingConstants
classes.description: Contains string constants related to streaming providers and namespaces.

classes.name: ReportingOptions
classes.description: A class representing configuration options for reporting, including report time and duration.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current value of a specified counter.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Asynchronously tracks activities or data related to a given grain.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the duration of the grain's run.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the wait time until the next report.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the total value for a specified counter.
